entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold for ten minutes. My VeloBand is a piece of junk and I want a refund right now.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your device. I can definitely look into this for you. To get started, could I get your name and order number?
The name is Evelyn Reed, order number is VF886-012. And don't give me the runaround, this thing is completely broken.

Thank you, Evelyn. I'm pulling up your order now. I understand your frustration. To make sure I'm addressing the right problem, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Are you kidding me? It's a technical fault! The pulse reader is wildly inaccurate and the whole thing is not working! It won't sync my workouts, it just fails every time. It's a defective product and I want my money back.
Okay, I see. Thank you for clarifying that for me. It sounds like the device isn't performing as it should at all.

No, it's not! So what are you going to do about it? I'm not spending an hour on the phone with your tech people. I want a return label and a refund. If you can't do that, get me your manager. I'm already writing a one-star review as we speak.
I understand you're upset, and I want to resolve this for you as quickly as possible. Let me just check our return policy for you. I see you received the VeloBand 21 days ago.
And? It's defective. It doesn't matter if I got it yesterday or 21 days ago.

You are absolutely right. I've just pulled up our policy here... and yes, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for this defective band. My apologies for the trouble it has caused.
Oh. Well, fine. That's what I wanted in the first place. Go ahead and do it then.

Of course. I've just initiated the return. You will receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. Just box the item up and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
You're very welcome, Evelyn. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you again for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
